19. LEASES/CONTRACTS/LEGAL:

h) Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Cheyenne and Cheyenne
Rotary Club Foundation regarding donation of Rotary Park to the City of Cheyenne.

Mr, Segrave moved to approve, seconded by Mr. Laybourn, Mr. Segrave moved to amend by
substitute dated August 7, 2023, seconded by Mr. Laybourn. Motion to amend carried by
unanimous Voice vote. Main motion, as amended, carried by unanimous voice vote.

Mayor Patrick Collins provided information related to the history of the proposed memorandum
of understanding. Tom Cobb, City Engineer, and Jason Sanchez, Community Recreation & Events
Director, provided additional information related to the City’s acquisition of the property. Robin
Sims, Cheyenne Rotary Foundation Board Treasurer, and Scott Meier provided additional
information related to the Cheyenne Rotary Club Foundation’s expectations for the property.
Stefanie Boster, City Attorney, provided an overview of the proposed substitute, Chairman Cook
and committee members Laybourn, Segrave, and Rinne commented on the item. Dr. Rinne and
Mr. Laybourn thanked the Cheyenne Rotary Club Foundation for their donation.

There being no further items for the agenda to come before the Public Services Committee, the
meeting was adjourned at 1:45 p.m.
